THE GAME ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512250/Paranormal_Torment

Paranormal Torment is a psychological horror game in the spirit of P.T., where you're trapped in a loop of memory and guilt, forced to relive a tragedy over and over again. He's still waiting for you to come back...
